h:
这是新发布的入门工作流程通量 2 开发由 ComfyUI 团队开发。

此工作流程旨在帮助您快速启动并运行新架构。它处理标准的文本到图像生成，但还包括一个设置参考图像调节（多模式输入）。

工作流程特点：

  • 标准生成：针对 Flux 2 Dev 进行校准

  • 参考输入：我已包含连接到 LoadImage 输入的 ReferenceLatent 节点。这允许您使用图像（类似于 IP 适配器/变体）与文本结合进行提示。

    • 注意：正如工作流程注释中所写，只需绕过（Ctrl+B）如果您只想进行纯文本到图像的操作，请使用参考节点。

  • 分辨率：默认设置为 1024x1024。

所需型号：
要正确使用此工作流程，请确保您的 ComfyUI 模型文件夹中有以下模型（或其等效模型）（工作流程中包含模型链接）：

  1. UNET/扩散：Flux2_dev_fp8mixed.safetensors

  2. 剪辑：Mistra_3_small_flux2_fp8.safetensors

  3. VAE：Flux2-vae.safetensors

使用方法：

  1. 加载工作流程。

  2. 确保在加载器中选择您的检查点。

  3. （可选）将图像上传到“加载图像”节点以测试参考功能，或将其静音以进行标准提示。

  4. 排队提示！

享受探索 Flux 2 的乐趣！如果您遇到任何问题，请告诉我。

o.en:
Here is a starter workflow for the newly releasedFlux 2 Devby the ComfyUI team.

This workflow is designed to get you up and running quickly with the new architecture. It handles standard Text-to-Image generation but also includes a setup forReference Image Conditioning(Multimodal input).

Workflow Features:

  • Standard Generation:calibrated for Flux 2 Dev.

  • Reference Inputs:I have included ReferenceLatent nodes connected to LoadImage inputs. This allows you to prompt using images (similar to IP-Adapter/Variations) combined with text.

    • Note:As written in the workflow notes, simplyBypass (Ctrl+B)the Reference nodes if you only want to do pure Text-to-Image.

  • Resolution:Defaults set to 1024x1024.

Required Models:
To use this workflow without errors, ensure you have the following models (or their equivalents) in your ComfyUI models folder(model links are included in the workflow):

  1. UNET/Diffusion:flux2_dev_fp8mixed.safetensors

  2. CLIP:mistral_3_small_flux2_fp8.safetensors

  3. VAE:flux2-vae.safetensors

How to use:

  1. Load the workflow.

  2. Ensure your checkpoints are selected in the Loaders.

  3. (Optional) Upload images to the "Load Image" nodes to test the reference capabilities, or mute them for standard prompting.

  4. Queue Prompt!

Enjoy exploring Flux 2! Let me know if you run into any issues.
